reason: The premises are mostly supported: E1 and E2 show thermal stability and irradiation resistance in RHEAs; E2 notes superior strength vs. Ni superalloys/W; E3 links lattice distortions and chemical complexity to irradiation tolerance; E4 demonstrates high strength and ductility in small-scale RHEAs. premises: RHEAs can exhibit high thermal stability and irradiation resistance
RHEAs can show superior high-temperature mechanical strength compared to Ni-based superalloys or pure W
High-entropy solid solutions with lattice distortions and chemical complexity improve irradiation tolerance
